Write an HTML report of the strain selection

Source: R/report_selection.R
report_selection.Rd

Renders an HTML report of a selection made with select_strains(): parameters and summary, silhouette curve with the optimal number of clusters and the maximum number of strains, list of the selected strains (with their metadata), optimal groups that are not represented, sizes of the clusters and description of the columns of the CSV file (which ones were used for the selection). Requires the rmarkdown package and pandoc.

Usage

report_selection(
  x,
  file = "strain_selection_report.html",
  data = NULL,
  id = 1,
  title = "Selection of strains to sequence",
  csv = TRUE
)

Arguments

x

An object returned by select_strains().

file

Path of the HTML file to write.

data

The original metadata table, or NULL to show only the metadata used for the selection (see export_selection()).

id

Name or position of the column of data containing the strain identifiers.

title

Title of the report.

csv

If TRUE (default), the table of export_selection() is also written as a CSV file next to the report (same name, .csv extension).

Value

The path of the HTML report, invisibly.

See also

Other clustering method: assess_gower(), cstats_table(), export_selection(), select_silhouette(), select_strains()

Examples

prepared_data <- prepare_input(
  salmonella_strains,
  col_select = c("CONTEXTE", "MATRICE1", "REGION", "SECTEUR", "LIEUPVT"),
  id = "IDENTIFIANT", date = "DATE_PRELEVEMENT"
)
#> no duplicate ID
#> selected metadata: CONTEXTE, MATRICE1, REGION, SECTEUR, LIEUPVT, ANNEE
res <- select_strains(prepared_data, n_max = 20, seed = 1)
if (requireNamespace("rmarkdown", quietly = TRUE) && rmarkdown::pandoc_available()) {
  report_selection(res, file = file.path(tempdir(), "selection.html"),
                   data = salmonella_strains, id = "IDENTIFIANT")
}
#> selection written to /tmp/Rtmpz8HtE5/selection.csv
#> report written to /tmp/Rtmpz8HtE5/selection.html
